## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `symbols` | ETF tickers; leave it out for every fund. | Massive's ticker for each symbol, spelled exactly as Massive spells it: `AAPL` or `BRK.B` for a stock, `O:SPY271217C00700000` (the OCC code) for an option, `I:SPX` for an index, `C:EURUSD` for a forex pair, `X:BTCUSD` for a crypto pair, and `ESZ6` for a future. Pass one symbol as text, several as a list, or a table with a `Symbol` column. A live table is followed: each symbol you add is read, and each one you delete stops being read. `last_by()`, `fetch()`, `history()`, and most polls also drop a deleted symbol's rows. `dm.ALL` reads every symbol, and leaving the argument out reads every record with no filter by symbol, where this dataset takes them. A misspelled symbol in text or a list raises `ValueError` at the call; by default, a misspelled row of a table is skipped and logged, and the table keeps running. `dm.canonical_symbol` converts other spellings to Massive's. A record that lists several symbols, such as a news article, appears once for each symbol you named that it lists. |
| `sort` | Any field of the rows, such as `"effective_date"`. | The field to order the rows by, named as Massive names it, such as `"ex_dividend_date"`. Where the endpoint allows, name several, separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc`: `"ticker,ex_dividend_date.desc"`. This page lists the values the dataset takes. |
| `order` | The direction of `sort`. | The direction of `sort`: `dm.Order.ASC` or `dm.Order.DESC`. |
| `limit` | The most rows to return, in total. | The most rows Massive returns for the whole request, across every symbol you name, kept in Massive's order: ask for newest first (`order=dm.Order.DESC`) to keep the latest. A symbol that comes first can use up the whole limit, so leave `limit` out when you need every row of each symbol. A `fetch()` that follows a table of symbols applies it to each symbol's request, and this dataset's own line says where else it applies to each symbol. |
| `filters` | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"effective_date_gte": "2026-01-01"}`. | Any other parameter Massive documents for this dataset, as a mapping from the parameter's name to its value, with each dot in the name written as `_`: Massive's `strike_price.gte` is `strike_price_gte`. This page lists the keys the dataset takes. A key it doesn't take, or one that has its own argument, such as `start`, raises `ValueError` naming the keys it does take. A date or time value takes ISO 8601 text, or any value `start` takes. |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `composite_ticker`: "The stock ticker symbol used to identify this ETF product on exchanges." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `EffectiveDate` | String | The date showing when the information was accurate or valid; some issuers, such as Vanguard, release their data on a delay, so the effective_date can be several weeks earlier than the processed_date. | REST |
| `ProcessedDate` | String | The date showing when ETF Global received and processed the data. | REST |
| `QuantCompositeBehavioral` | double | Behavioral analysis score measuring investor psychology and market behavior patterns. | REST |
| `QuantCompositeFundamental` | double | Overall fundamental analysis score combining P/E, P/CF, P/B, and dividend yield metrics. | REST |
| `QuantCompositeGlobal` | double | Overall global theme score combining sector and country analysis for macro investment views. | REST |
| `QuantCompositeQuality` | double | Overall quality assessment score combining liquidity, diversification, and issuing firm factors. | REST |
| `QuantCompositeSentiment` | double | Overall market sentiment score combining put/call ratios, short interest, and implied volatility. | REST |
| `QuantCompositeTechnical` | double | Combined technical analysis score aggregating short, intermediate, and long-term technical factors. | REST |
| `QuantFundamentalDiv` | double | Fundamental analysis score based on dividend yields of the ETF's underlying securities. | REST |
| `QuantFundamentalPb` | double | Fundamental analysis score based on price-to-book value ratios of the ETF's holdings. | REST |
| `QuantFundamentalPcf` | double | Fundamental analysis score based on price-to-cash-flow ratios of the ETF's underlying assets. | REST |
| `QuantFundamentalPe` | double | Fundamental analysis score based on price-to-earnings ratios of the ETF's underlying holdings. | REST |
| `QuantGlobalCountry` | double | Quantitative score analyzing global country themes and country-specific market factors. | REST |
| `QuantGlobalSector` | double | Quantitative score analyzing global sector themes and sector-specific performance factors. | REST |
| `QuantGrade` | String | Letter grade summarizing the ETF's overall quantitative assessment, where A = 71-100, B = 56-70, etc. | REST |
| `QuantQualityDiversification` | double | Quality assessment score evaluating the diversification benefits and risk distribution of the ETF. | REST |
| `QuantQualityFirm` | double | Quality assessment score evaluating the reputation and capabilities of the ETF's issuing firm. | REST |
| `QuantQualityLiquidity` | double | Quality assessment score measuring the liquidity characteristics and trading ease of the ETF. | REST |
| `QuantSentimentIv` | double | Market sentiment score derived from implied volatility levels in options markets. | REST |
| `QuantSentimentPc` | double | Market sentiment score derived from put/call option ratios and options activity. | REST |
| `QuantSentimentSi` | double | Market sentiment score based on short interest levels and short selling activity. | REST |
| `QuantTechnicalIt` | double | Intermediate-term technical analysis score evaluating medium-term price trends. | REST |
| `QuantTechnicalLt` | double | Long-term technical analysis score assessing extended price trend patterns. | REST |
| `QuantTechnicalSt` | double | Short-term technical analysis score based on recent price movements and trading patterns. | REST |
| `QuantTotalScore` | double | ETF Global's comprehensive quantitative analysis score combining all quantitative factors. | REST |
| `RewardScore` | double | ETF Global's proprietary Green Diamond score measuring the potential reward and return prospects of the ETF. | REST |
| `RiskCountry` | double | A component score assessing country-specific risks based on the ETF's geographic exposure. | REST |
| `RiskDeviation` | double | A component score measuring how much the ETF deviates from expected performance. | REST |
| `RiskEfficiency` | double | A component score assessing the operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness of the ETF. | REST |
| `RiskLiquidity` | double | A component score measuring the liquidity risk and ease of trading the ETF. | REST |
| `RiskStructure` | double | A component score evaluating risks related to the ETF's structural design and mechanics. | REST |
| `RiskTotalScore` | double | ETF Global's proprietary Red Diamond overall risk assessment score for the ETF. | REST |
| `RiskVolatility` | double | A component score measuring the volatility risk of the ETF's price movements. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
